headline: Frontier Bases Shift as Heavy Fighting Intensifies
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ledger shows renewed movement on several fronts rather than a settled line. Callums Cape remains the busiest theatre, adding two events in the latest two hours and reaching 38 in 24 hours; its bases stand four Warden, two Colonial and one neutral. Mooring County has quickened markedly, with six recent events and 25 for the day, while Wardens retain 10 of 12 bases. Linn Mercy has also resumed immediate activity, recording two events in two hours and 22 across the day; nine bases are Colonial-held, one Warden-held and one neutral. Weathered Expanse has three fresh events and 18 daily, with six Warden bases, one Colonial base and two neutral. Stonecradle is now among the sharper live sectors, posting six events in two hours and nine daily, though all nine bases currently fly Colonial colors. Marban Hollow likewise remains contested, with four recent events and 13 daily, split five Colonial, two Warden and one neutral. Nevish Line and Godcrofts retain notable daily churn but have gone quiet in the latest two-hour window. Casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating in the principal contested regions.
